How this blog is written

One post per surface of the product, written against the build that shipped it, revised in place rather than reposted. Every figure quoted in a post is one the app computes — there are no estimates, no predictions and no signals here. Where a post describes a mechanism, the arithmetic behind it is stated on the methodology page.

22 posts, 17,934 words. The same articles read inside the app at /#/blog, where each one carries illustrations drawn in the browser rather than image files.

Open the desk — free, no account — no account, nothing to install

DexLadder is a free, keyless gateway to Web3 — live on-chain markets, real AMM mechanics, derivatives, strategy bots and your own contracts. No account, no wallet connection, no key ever requested. Capital in the trading desk is simulated, so nothing can be deposited, withdrawn or lost, and everything stays on your device.
